title: Channel giveaway response (PRF-02 slice 6, catalogue module #17)
description: The creator-facing projection of the channel's current giveaway, or null when none is open. Available at EVERY tier: storing, viewing and exporting a durable creator record is never tier-gated (12.6). The Creator+/Events Pack entitlement governs only whether the Master Canvas renders the Giveaway / Tournament card. closedAt is a record of when the creator closed the giveaway, never a schedule and never a result. The giveaway carries NO winner, draw method, seed, odds or weighting -- 17.1 decided on 2026-09-13 that only free-entry and skill-based formats ship, supporter-weighted odds are not built, and GIV-07 gates chance-based formats on legal review that has not happened. It carries NO prize description, value, escrow, custody, fulfilment, delivery, tracking, address or claim field: BharatStudio never holds, escrows, ships or guarantees a prize, and the creator is the promoter, responsible for eligibility, taxes and delivery. It carries NO entry fee or price of any kind and NO entrant or participant list -- there is no entry path in this slice at all, so nothing a payment could gate and nothing that correlates one visit to another.

giveawayId.description: Present on the CREATOR projection only, because the creator's write path is addressed rather than ambient -- a stale dashboard tab must not be able to write a count onto a giveaway opened after it loaded. It is never on the overlay projection.

entryOpensAt.description: Recorded when the creator opened the giveaway. Scheduling one to open later is a separate 30.3 row and is not built here.

entryClosesAt.description: The instant the creator supplied for the published entry window to close. Always after entryOpensAt.

closedAt.description: When the creator closed the giveaway. Null while it is open. Never a scheduled close, and never a result -- closing produces no announcement, because a winner announcement requires consent (17.1) that no mechanism in this schema provides.
